fact_role: exact replayable result of one exact EmpiricalQuerySpec against one exact governed empirical substrate/source scope

fact_states.ASSERTABLE: all identity, authority, source, predicate, risk-set, target, topology and measure requirements resolve exactly; denominator is positive under the selected measure
fact_states.VALID_EMPTY: the governing query/domain contract resolves coherently to an empty fact family or empty target domain without representing missing authority, zero support or failure
fact_states.ZERO_SUPPORT: the exact denominator membership resolves and has zero support; no conditional probability is fabricated
fact_states.ZERO_OVERLAP: a required common-eligibility or same-respondent overlap risk set resolves exactly to zero members
fact_states.NOT_APPLICABLE: exact routing/applicability authority declares the requested target/risk-set inapplicable
fact_states.DENIED: exact authority denies the requested empirical use/query
fact_states.DEFERRED: exact authority makes the result nonpositive pending a named unresolved condition; no positive fact is fabricated
fact_states.NONCOMPARABLE: exact source/time/semantic relation authority says required comparison/composition is not lawful
fact_states.MISSING_REQUIRED_AUTHORITY: a required named authority is absent; not equivalent to zero or denial
fact_states.UNKNOWN_OR_CONFLICTING_AUTHORITY: required authority exists only ambiguously or conflicts without exact governed precedence
fact_states.UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_RELATION: multiple source universes require a relation/composition/linkage decision that cannot be resolved exactly
fact_states.UNSUPPORTED_RESPONSE_TOPOLOGY: source/question topology is known to require distinctions the selected query carrier cannot faithfully represent
fact_states.INTEGRITY_FAILURE: hash/schema/reference/replay/coherence failure before a lawful empirical result can be asserted

cell_states.OBSERVED_POSITIVE: positive numerator in a positive exact denominator
cell_states.OBSERVED_ZERO_IN_SUPPORTED_RISK_SET: exact numerator is zero while exact denominator is positive; empirical nonobservation, not metaphysical impossibility
cell_states.LOW_SUPPORT: cell is supported but falls under an exact low-support/uncertainty condition; it remains distinct from zero and absence
cell_states.TYPED_SPECIAL_RESPONSE_STATE: DK/refusal/IAP/not-asked/inapplicable/other state when exact query authority intentionally includes that state in the target domain

typed_state_noncollapse: absence_of_materialized_row != any typed state without replay proof

distribution_law.primary_empirical_fact: complete governed target topology/distribution or joint configuration table for the exact query

uncertainty_law.when_numeric_estimator_used: exact method/design authority/version/hash becomes fact identity/provenance
uncertainty_law.when_no_numeric_estimator_governed: retain typed unquantified uncertainty state; do not invent estimator

hostile_identity_cases.required: different fact IDs because query/predicate identities differ
different fact IDs even when denominator count is equal
different fact IDs because measure basis differs

hostile_identity_cases.case: same canonical labels different source releases
hostile_identity_cases.required: different source-indexed fact IDs absent exact authorized composition
different fact content/IDs because complete joint cells differ
joint/conjunction fact remains assertable from exact incidence; no unary-score starvation
pooled and stratified query/fact IDs remain distinct; reversal comparison is derived

hostile_identity_cases.case: branch label reused after branch definition change
hostile_identity_cases.required: different fact identity because branch replay/predicate hash changes
no semantic state change; exact fact is reconstructible from C11-equivalent carrier
